// diagnostic

E0437

`<>` is outside a pipe step

What

`<>` is outside a pipe step

Why

`<>` is the value a `|> step` receives from the line above; outside a step there is no such value

Fix

move it into a step such as `value |> f(<>)`, or write the value itself

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0437: tests/ui/pipe_value_outside_step.stderr.

Error [jet.PipeValueOutsideStep]: `<>` is outside a pipe step

  3 |     print(<> + port)
    |           ^^
 Why: `<>` is the value a `|> step` receives from the line above; outside a step there is no such value
 Fix: Move it into a step such as `value |> f(<>)`, or write the value itself
